sentences.en: The villagers have done without electricity for a long time.
sentences.zh: 村民们很久都没有用过电。

sentences.en: It takes a lot of electricity to power a country.
sentences.zh: 要为一个国家供电需要大量的电力。

sentences.en: Can you imagine what our lives would be like without electricity?
sentences.zh: 你能想象没有电我们的生活会是什么样子吗？
